title.heading: Harlow Creek Health System
title.subheading: A fictional hospital and health system website with find a doctor, locations, services, patient resources, events, careers and a staff portal.

end.heading: Built with Raytha
end.subheading: Open-source .NET CMS. Get the brief, screenshots and a one-command rebuild kit.

Hospital, urgent care, clinics and specialty centers

Staff sign in for clinical policy digests and onboarding
